presentation.title: SZL Atelier
presentation.summary: Explore models, datasets and Spaces through their source ownership and publication evidence. Atelier brings artifact records and bounded public provider observations into one inspectable interface.
visible_limits: Declared Hub identities and source records do not establish current runtime success or exact provider readback.
Public provider metadata readback is opt-in and restricted to curated SZLHOLDINGS identities.
This application does not execute models, mutate the Hub or grant release or action authority.

cards.publisher_readme_mapping: frontier/atelier_v3/PUBLICATION.json maps SPACE_README.md to README.md. build_publication.py copies all nine controlled source files and generates SOURCE_REVISION and PUBLICATION_RECEIPT.json for the existing publish_space.py writer.
cards.publication_trigger: Existing workflow_run after successful ci for a main push, with exact tested/current-main checks; existing workflow_dispatch retains its exact confirmation. No event is dispatched by this preparation.
cards.publication_boundary: The existing fixed-target publisher retains exact current-source checks, Hub parent-commit protection, immutable package/file readback, runtime convergence and application source probes. This card change does not invoke the writer or alter any model-card route, runtime code, catalog, frozen artifact or qualification label.
